mcqs.question: In quadrilateral ABCD, AB is parallel to CD and AD is parallel to BC. Which of the following pairs are opposite sides?
mcqs.explanation: Opposite sides of a quadrilateral are the sides that do not share a common vertex. In ABCD, side AB does not meet side CD, so they are opposite. Adjacent sides share a vertex, such as AB and BC. Therefore option B is correct.

mcqs.question: A kite has vertices P, Q, R, S in order. Angles ∠P and ∠R each measure 70°, while ∠Q and ∠S each measure 110°. Which statement is true about opposite angles?
mcqs.explanation: Opposite angles are those that are not adjacent; they are formed at vertices that are not next to each other. In the kite, vertices P and R are non‑adjacent, so ∠P and ∠R are opposite. Option A correctly identifies them.

mcqs.question: A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of opposite sides parallel. Which of the following must be true?

options.A: Both pairs of opposite sides are parallel

mcqs.explanation: A quadrilateral with at least one pair of opposite sides parallel is defined as a trapezium (or trapezoid). Having only one parallel pair does not guarantee a rectangle or a parallelogram, and it certainly means at least one pair is parallel, so option C is the only statement that must be true.

mcqs.question: In quadrilateral ABCD, the diagonals intersect at O, are perpendicular to each other, and bisect each other. Which type of quadrilateral must ABCD be?
mcqs.explanation: When the diagonals of a quadrilateral bisect each other, the figure is a parallelogram. If, in addition, the diagonals are perpendicular, the parallelogram is a rhombus (a square is a special case). Hence the required quadrilateral is a rhombus, making option B correct.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly compares a square, rectangle, rhombus and a general parallelogram?

options.B: Only the square has all sides equal and all angles right
options.C: Rectangle and rhombus both have opposite sides equal, but only the rectangle has all angles right
options.D: A parallelogram always has perpendicular diagonals

mcqs.answer: Rectangle and rhombus both have opposite sides equal, but only the rectangle has all angles right
mcqs.explanation: In a rectangle, opposite sides are equal and all interior angles are 90°. In a rhombus, all sides are equal and opposite sides are parallel, but the angles need not be right. A square satisfies both conditions, while a generic parallelogram only guarantees opposite sides equal and parallel. Therefore option C accurately captures the comparison.

mcqs.learning_point: Use properties to identify an unknown quadrilateral
mcqs.question: A quadrilateral has both pairs of opposite sides parallel, all four sides are equal, and one interior angle measures 90°. Which quadrilateral is it?
mcqs.explanation: Both pairs of opposite sides parallel indicate a parallelogram. All sides equal makes it a rhombus. Adding a right angle forces all angles to be right, which together define a square. Hence the only quadrilateral satisfying all three conditions is a square.

mcqs.question: In any quadrilateral, which pair of sides are opposite sides?

options.A: Sides that share a common vertex
options.B: Sides that do not share a vertex

mcqs.answer: Sides that do not share a vertex
mcqs.explanation: Opposite sides are defined as the two sides that are not adjacent; they do not meet at any vertex. Option B correctly describes this relationship.

mcqs.question: In quadrilateral WXYZ, which pair of angles are opposite angles?
mcqs.explanation: Opposite angles are those located at vertices that are not next to each other. In WXYZ, vertices W and Y are non‑adjacent, so ∠W and ∠Y are opposite angles. Option B correctly identifies them.
